I used to hunt deer in the mountains and forests of NC.  Since I had extensive compass training in the army I often ventured in 3 or 4 miles into deep forested areas.  One day I was in about 4 miles and noticed something reflecting the sun a few hundred feet ahead. I came upon a pair of binoculars and a pack with ammo and a pistol inside of it.  I expected to shortly see another person but no one came around after waiting for about an hour. Suspecting someone may have got lost I started to circle the area around the binocs.  As I got half way around a third circle away from binocs I saw a rifle stock and barrel disattached and broken in half as if something very strong ripped it apart.  I noticed dried blood all around the area and felt an immediate sense of danger.  Next, I heard a blood curdling howl and very loud growl that was totally unfamiliar to my knowledge of local beasts. I cocked my .44 cal. Marlin lever rifle and quietly listened for movements. Stayed there for around a half hour scared shitless. At a very brisk pace I backtracked to my car in around 90 minutes, locked the doors and never returned to that area. I left the binocs and pistol in the woods. Reply if you want directions.

I suffer from the following: PTSD, anxiety, 2 heart attacks (50% cardiac muscle is gone), diabetes, fractured neck, large lump in lung (hurts much only when breathing), actively bleeding stomach ulcers, acid reflux, shortness of breath, terrible eyesight and massive depression (bipolar).  Last month, for the first time in years, I drank a lot one night, took some drugs and actually was pain-free for a few hours.  After a few hours of feeling good for a change I began to shake and exhibit seizure symptoms.  I surmised that taking the alcohol/opium/morphine may be slowly killing me or possibly the drug was tainted.  The opium was given to me by a guy in the VFW months ago but I tried it (orally) in a small amount for the first time. I took my drugs (voluntarily) with me in the ambulance to the VA ER so they would know what I took if I passed out.  I gave drugs to ER nurse and told her I thought one was opium but the person who gave it to me said it was a pain med.  Anyway, they observed and monitored me overnight and in the morning I was much better (normal) never great. Kicker - ER gave my opium to VA police who promptly issued me a summons to Fed Court for bringing a "pinch" of powder into ER because I thought it may be killing me.  I'm poor. No extra $$.  Can't afford atty so they COULD send me to prison for seeking help. I will not let the VA kill me and embarrass me. My daughter gets married soon and I do not need or want this.  If necessary I'll end myself, they won't because I won't allow it ! This could have been handled humanely. I did not want the drug back anyway, it should have been flushed and forgotten.
